author: Mike Kasberg
unitAssumption: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.socket: Retain 4.50 mm slot length; slot width = sheet + total allowance
mapping.fit: Measured ~.100012 mm surplus informs proposed .15 mm total allowance, range .10–.30; not physically calibrated
mapping.tongue: New 4.50 minus allowance mm tongue through sole thickness, shoulder stops at sole top
mapping.carrier: New one/two/two-bay card with twenty bed-level .4–.6 mm runners, cut outside functional interfaces

newGeometry.assemblySequence: Insert each anchor along Z into two sole sockets, glue four fixed seats and cure, then thread through anchor eyes and alternating heddle slits/eyes, tie yarn with modest hand tension. Loose heddle is hand-held, not captured.
newGeometry.shuttlePath: Thin sheet axis vertical, 6 mm web along warp; pass long axis across warp at X=6 mm from heddle, full ±5 mm lift. Test 0.8 mm yarn tubes and exact shuttle solids. Minimum ideal shed at outer X=9 edge = 5*(1-9/(anchor separation/2)); subtract yarn diameter and sheet thickness.
newGeometry.mechanismLimits: No guide/capture, no force/tension simulation, yarn excluded from printable geometry, no physical weaving validation.
newGeometry.art: Exact image/STL Boolean engraving in 6.5 mm radial sole keep-in, .4–.6 mm deep; at least 1 mm backing

differenceFromPriorApps: New rigid-heddle slot/eye shed routing and actual thin-shuttle passage, not a circular loom, tablet weaving kit, geometric sculpture or cosmetic reskin. Shared local import/editor/export infrastructure is adapted; generator and assembly checks are new.
